children.text: is a powerful kalphite found within the

just north of Menaphos. KK can use three combat styles, but he will only use one style at a time with a set attack rotation for each style. At any time throughout the fight, KK can randomly change attack style, starting a new attack rotation.

KK is a significant step up in difficulty in comparison to other mid-tier bosses, requiring close tracking of auto attacks and specs, and the use of specific abilites at certain times to dodge one-hit mechanics.
Being on a Kalphite slayer task
is recommended as you gain the benefits of the Slayer Helm

⬥ Ranged Phase: 2 Autos → Stun → 2 Autos → Green → 2 Autos → Dig → Repeat
⬥ Melee Phase: 2 Autos → Push → 2 Autos → Charge → 2 Autos → Green → Repeat
⬥ Mage Phase: 4 Autos → Dig → 2 Autos → Charge → Repeat
​

⬥ Kalphite King stuns and binds the tank for 8 seconds, leaving them unable to do anything. He then deals a melee attack that can hit up to 32k damage. Greens only happen during ranged and melee phase.

• Ranged phase: the Green can be skipped via stunning KK at the right time.
    • Melee phase: you cannot skip the Green, instead you must utilise the Bladed Dive technique discussed later.
​
⬥ Kalphite King heals 75% of all damage dealt by players.
⬥ Kalphite King heals 100% of all damage dealt to players.

⬥ Kalphite King becomes unattackable and digs under the ground for 10 seconds, it then appears under the player it last targeted, dealing up to 5k damage if not avoided. Digs only happen on ranged and magic phase.

⬥ Kalphite King becomes unattackable and charges towards a wall, players who fail to avoid the space between the charging boss and wall will be hit up to 4k damage. Charges only happen on melee and magic phase.

⬥ Kalphite King spawns minions when it reaches 195k (1 wave) and 65k HP (2 waves). All players within a 3 tile radius of KK will be stunned for one second before the minions appear. Minions spawning will also cause KK to skip whatever attack he would have done next, including special attacks.
Stunning KK at the right time is essential, allowing you skip certain mechanics that either waste time (charge & dig) or result in a death/failed kill (Green).
